definition: the narrow middle of the body above the hips
description: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie lässt einen Hula-Hoop-Reifen um ihre Taille kreisen.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está haciendo girar un aro alrededor de la cintura.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la joven?

fr.answer: Elle fait tourner un cerceau autour de sa taille.
fr.question: Que fait la jeune femme ?
